title: Batch 162 — eight in-place Hebrew Sicha enrichments and one no-duplicate recheck
review_method: Manual public web/open inspection of nine accessible Hebrew BeitChabad/Chabad.org source bodies. Eight distinct passages were paraphrased and attached to eight existing canonical identities; one additional identity was rechecked but not enriched because its existing proposition already covers the exact locator. AID 2987993 returned Internal Error and was excluded; AID 2988866 was opened as an accessible alternative in the same run. AID 2988866 remains non-independent because the publisher notes a Yiddish editorial parallel; no translation was counted as an independent witness. No title or search snippet was used as content; no crawler retry, access-control bypass or full-text reproduction.

blocked_candidates.reason: The public reader returned Internal Error; no readable body was exposed. No crawler retry or access-control bypass.

excluded_candidates.reason: The public reader returned Internal Error; no readable body was exposed. No crawler retry or access-control bypass.
excluded_candidates.handling: Excluded; no content inferred. Accessible AID 2988866 was opened and inspected as same-run fallback.

fallback_source_results.note: AID 2988866 was opened at section ח׳, lines 223–232, and enriched in its existing Evidence Family; its Yiddish editorial parallel was not counted as an independent witness.

metrics_note: Planning boundary only: prior PR-head batch161 expected 1530/854/3951; batch162 adds eight propositions to eight existing identities and no new source identity or Verified promotion, so expected 1530/854/3959. These are not measured metrics. The public main metrics remain 977/878/2950 until full reconciliation is committed.

deduplication_check.note: Eight target AIDs were matched to their existing canonical files and Evidence Family IDs; the exact-AID filter found no queue matches. AID 3008863 was rechecked and excluded from enrichment because its canonical proposition already covers the inspected locator. Full-index uniqueness and answer-eligibility audit pending.
